programs.description: Murali saves Lakshmi from an abusive marriage and shelters her at his house. However, all hell breaks loose when Murali's girlfriend finds out about their living situation.
An egoistic moneylender dreams of finding a wealthy bride for his son. However, her dreams are shattered after his son falls in love with a poor damsel.
A young man in severe debt believes that the only way to pay it off is through the dowry from his impending marriage. However, the death of his grandfather puts his plan on hold.
Chenna is smitten by Cheluvi, a girl who works in his factory. However, with Chenna's jealous manager in the picture, the lovers struggle to enjoy their developing romance.
Raj, a small-time private detective who is desperate for a big break, gets drawn into a political conspiracy when he is hired to rescue a hostage.
Doctor Aakarsh, who is separated from his wife, Adithi, falls in love with another girl, Acchari. He is caught in a fix when his estranged wife comes back.
A sinister man tries to defame the village landlord and create trouble for the village. However, the landlord is determined to stand tough against all the allegations.
Four people from different fields embark on an unusual self-discovery journey, only to find their paths unexpectedly converging near the end, uniting them in transformation.
A senior crime inspector investigates a complex case of people going missing in Bengaluru, taking every measure possible to uncover the truth.
A couple in love harbour dark secrets from each other. When the two realise that they share the same goal, which is to avenge the deaths of their families, their paths align.
Raj, a small-time private detective who is desperate for a big break, gets drawn into a political conspiracy when he is hired to rescue a hostage.
Couples representing different villages manage to bear children as a symbol of unity. However, Kireek, a cunning man, tries to convert their love into hatred which results in riots.

Karan, an aimless young man, joins the Indian Army on a whim but backs out when he finds a soldier's life to be difficult. When this creates conflict with his girlfriend, he rejoins to make her proud.
Venkatesha, a taxi driver, drives Sister Martha to a spiritual place and tries to make her journey interesting by narrating stories.
Vicky breaks his engagement with Priya, his childhood friend, after he learns that she is making many compromises for his sake. However, time makes him realise the need for compromises in life.

Gultoo is a 2018 Indian Kannada language cyber-thriller film written and directed by Janardhan Chikkanna. Produced by Prashant Reddy and Devraja R, the film's music is scored by Amit Anand. Naveen Shankar and Sonu Gowda feature in lead roles along with Rangayana Raghu, Avinash playing the supporting characters. Shanti Sagar is the cinematographer of the film, under the banner of Vivid Films.
Directors Special
Raj, born into a wealthy family and known for living life to the fullest, discovers a woman named Hamsa through a deceased man's diary. He finds himself falling in love with her.

Karan, an aimless young man, joins the Indian Army on a whim but backs out when he finds a soldier's life to be difficult. When this creates conflict with his girlfriend, he rejoins to make her proud.
A photographer named Arun befriends Rajashekhara, a wealthy but lonely man who has resorted to drinking to quell his pain. Soon, Arun agrees to help him reunite with his estranged family.
The honest son of a vegetable vendor finds himself embroiled in a world of deceit and manipulation when he falls in love with the daughter of a police commissioner.
A Marathi woman, Reema, and a Kannadiga man, Kanti, fall in love. Their romantic story takes a political turn when Samblekar, a Maharashtrian politician, wants to exploit the situation.
Three college friends decide to open a resort. However, their lives change when they start experiencing paranormal activities in their resort.
News spreads that on a full moon day, if people submerge in the water running from the falls near a Nagakali Amman temple, they will be cured of any disease. Soon, the temple gets overcrowded.
Five men coincidentally bump into one another at a traffic junction. A sudden, tragic incident takes place, adversely affecting the course of their lives.

Kalleshappa forces his wife to contest in the district council election which is reserved for women. Once she becomes the president he starts interfering in the administrative decision-making process.
The honest son of a vegetable vendor finds himself embroiled in a world of deceit and manipulation when he falls in love with the daughter of a police commissioner.
Karthik falls in love with Sowbhagya on his visit to her village. After marriage, they head to Mysuru, where a mystery connected to her unfolds.
A celebrated police officer's run of success is shockingly interrupted by V, a mysterious killer, who specifically challenges him to end his killing spree.
Deepu, the daughter of a rich businessman, falls in love with her driver, Manu. Problems arise when Manu suffers a brain injury and is blamed for the death of an MLA's brother.
Krishna loves Mahalakshmi, whose brother works for a don. During a gang fight, the brother asks Krishna to protect some children and return them to their parents.
Vishwa, Sathya, Baswa and Adarsh are determined to make it big in the movie industry. However, with fate and ego not often on their side, they struggle to achieve their star-studded dreams.
Muniya's debt-ridden father mortgages him to his master after he runs out of money to pay his dues. When Muniya grows up and aspires to cultivate a land of his own, his master thwarts his every move.

Hottegagi Genu Battegagi is a 2018 Indian Kannada language drama film written and directed by Narendra Babu. Produced by Sudarshan G, Ramamurthy H R and Harish Sherigar, the film's music is scored by Ramchandra Hadapad. Anant Nag, Radhika Chetan, Gitanjali Rai feature in the main roles. P K H Das is the cinematographer of the film, under the banner of ACME Movies International.
A celebrated police officer's run of success is shockingly interrupted by V, a mysterious killer, who specifically challenges him to end his killing spree.
In the backdrop of an impending election, a fierce rivalry ensues between two political opponents, which threatens to boil over to their families and communities.
A genius mathematician uses his skills to assassinate his targets and stay clear of law enforcement. However, a vigilante secretly tracks his movements, vying for revenge.
Vijay takes in Hema, who pretends to be speech-impaired but hides a dark past, along with her brother, Sundareshwar. As secrets unfold, Vijay discovers the shocking truth.
An NRI seeks the help of a television crew to sell his haunted ancestral property. However, the daughter of a wealthy man gets kidnapped and is held hostage in the same bungalow.
Nandini, a young doctor, falls in love with Jessie, a happy-go-lucky man. But when Nandini gets married to Shyam Prasad at her parents' insistence, Jessie comes back in her life as a ghost.
Krishna is a loving father who dotes on his daughter, Anju. However, things take a turn when Anju decides to get him remarried, thereby bringing him face-to-face with his former wife.
Raam's life turns upside down when his beloved mother is killed. Things take a turn for the worse when he ends up accused of her murder.
A genius mathematician uses his skills to assassinate his targets and stay clear of law enforcement. However, a vigilante secretly tracks his movements, vying for revenge.
Deeply affected by his father's death and the plight of farmers, Basav seeks justice. Later, he courageously stands up against corrupt authorities and powerful figures.
Shankar, an assassin, is on the run after murdering a politician. When a twist of fate gives him the memories of a slain police officer, he must help the authorities find a murderer.
Three strangers desire to make it big in the dog-eat-dog movie industry. When the aspirants stumble into each other, they decide to join forces and conquer their dreams together.
The son of a disgraced boxer decides to pursue his father's passion and avenge his humiliation against the wishes of his mother.
A young woman named Anna is kidnapped by a few men who then proceed to torture her. However, Anna's situation takes a turn when a great power possesses her.
Arjun seeks to change the education system by putting his life at risk to nationalise private schools in the country. Will he succeed in his efforts?
Raja, a dancer, vows to take revenge on a rich man for killing his father. He falls in love with Radha, but little does he know that she is the daughter of the man who killed his father.
Shankar, an assassin, is on the run after murdering a politician. When a twist of fate gives him the memories of a slain police officer, he must help the authorities find a murderer.

Vaasu is the typical happy-go-lucky youngster. He lands up at a police station, where he asks the inspector to write an FIR that he will kill his girlfriend. When questioned why, one gets to listen to his love story, which is 'pakka commercial'.
Lord Rama rescues his wife, Sita, from Ravana and returns to Ayodhya. However, due to an unexpected turn of events, he exiles Sita, after which she faces several challenges.
Purmy, a vegetable auctioneer who is fascinated with brands, gets framed for kidnapping John, the school going son of a businessman, after he picks up an abandoned bag found on the road.
When tragedy hits the life of a young cook, he decides to heal himself and those around him by evoking nostalgia through his culinary prowess.

Kaafi Thota is a 2017 Indian romantic thriller Kannada film written, directed and co-produced by T. N. Seetharam.[1] Adapting a crowdfunding methodology, Seetharam produced the film along with 29 other donors under the maiden banner Manvanthara Films.
A French businessman crosses paths with an Indian autorickshaw driver in the city of Bengaluru. Together, they set out on a twisted journey through the city.
Kannappa, a hunter, hunts a deer and offers it to Lord Shiva, but soon punishes himself after watching the god bleed through his eyes.
Lord Rama rescues his wife, Sita, from Ravana and returns to Ayodhya. However, due to an unexpected turn of events, he exiles Sita, after which she faces several challenges.
Chanchala, an IAS officer, is imprisoned in a haunted house for interrogation. However, things take an unexpected turn when she gets possessed by a spirit.
Bringing the best in television.
A village living in harmony faces challenges when politicians try to divide the people based on caste. Subsequently, female villagers take up the task of fighting the oppressors.
A man with fetal alcohol syndrome keeps himself alive by drinking a certain amount of alcohol. However, things change when he falls in love with a beautiful woman.
